==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{FFG|book=|text=|story=|stext=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|book}} Link to the book's [[Wookieepedia]] article.
*{{Para|story}} Link to story's Wookieepedia article.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|text}} Formatted title of the book.
*{{Para|stext}} Formatted title of the story.

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{FFG|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Game Master's Kit|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Game Master's Kit|story=Dead in the Water|stext=Dead in the ''Water''}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{FFG|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Game Master's Kit|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Game Master's Kit|story=Dead in the Water|stext=Dead in the ''Water''}}
